$comment: Shared table for the hdf-to-csaf-vex CVSS score export, read by both converters/hdf-to-csaf-vex/go/schema_validation_test.go and converters/hdf-to-csaf-vex/typescript/schema-validation.test.ts, so the completeness rule and the severity mapping are asserted against ONE definition in both languages. Each case is an HDF Cvss block as it sits on an override for `cve` whose single affectedPackages entry carries `product` as its purl or cpe; `want` is the CSAF scores[] entry the exporter must emit, or null when the block cannot satisfy the FIRST.org schema CSAF binds its version to, in which case `warning` is the message the exporter must log instead (null when the block is enrichment-only and is skipped silently). Every emitting case is additionally validated against the vendored CSAF schema, and the full output of every case is frozen as expected/cvss-<name>.csaf-vex.json by Go and asserted byte-identical by TypeScript. Data provenance: CVE-2021-44228 (Log4Shell) carries the CVSS 3.1 (10.0 CRITICAL) and CVSS 2.0 (9.3 HIGH) base vectors NVD publishes for it, against log4j-core 2.14.1, a vulnerable release; CVE-2017-5638 (Apache Struts S2-045) carries NVD's CVSS 3.0 (10.0 CRITICAL) against struts2-core 2.3.31, the last vulnerable 2.3 release; the CVSS 4.0 vector is the HDF schema's own Cvss example for CVE-2024-21762 (FortiOS SSL VPN, 7.4.2 affected per FG-IR-24-015) with its base score computed by hdf-utilities computeCvss40Score, which is parity-tested against FIRST's 4.0 reference vectors (9.3, not the 9.8 the schema example lists, which is that CVE's 3.1 score). Every vector validates under hdf-utilities validateCvssVector for its version, and every 3.1 score was recomputed with computeCvssScore.

severity.$comment: HDF Cvss_Severity to the FIRST.org severityType enum (cvss-v3.0.json, cvss-v3.1.json and cvss-v4.0.json). The five bands are the same; FIRST spells them uppercase. CVSS 2.0 defines no qualitative severity, so cvss_v2 carries none. The tests also check these values against the enum in the vendored cvss-v3.1.json, so this table cannot drift from the schema either.

cases.name: v31-complete
cases.why: a complete 3.1 block is exported with its severity in FIRST's uppercase enum

cases.name: v31-no-vector
cases.why: a 3.1 score without its vector (Twistlock/Prisma shape) is legal HDF but cannot satisfy cvss-v3.1.json
cases.warning: hdf-to-csaf-vex: CVE-2021-44228: CVSS 3.1 score not exported, CSAF requires vectorString

cases.name: v31-no-severity
cases.why: a 3.1 vector and score without the severity band is legal HDF; the band is not synthesized
cases.warning: hdf-to-csaf-vex: CVE-2021-44228: CVSS 3.1 score not exported, CSAF requires baseSeverity

cases.name: v31-no-score
cases.why: a 3.1 vector without its score is legal HDF; the score is not recomputed
cases.warning: hdf-to-csaf-vex: CVE-2021-44228: CVSS 3.1 score not exported, CSAF requires baseScore

cases.name: v31-score-only
cases.why: the minimal legal HDF block, version and baseScore, is short two of the four fields cvss-v3.1.json requires
cases.warning: hdf-to-csaf-vex: CVE-2021-44228: CVSS 3.1 score not exported, CSAF requires vectorString, baseSeverity

cases.name: v31-enrichment-only
cases.why: consumer threat enrichment with no base metrics is the designed riskAdjustment shape; CSAF scores carry base metrics, so nothing exportable was lost and no warning is raised

cases.name: v30-complete
cases.why: CSAF binds cvss_v3 to either cvss-v3.0.json or cvss-v3.1.json by the version field; 3.0 shares 3.1's required set and uppercase enum

cases.name: v20-complete
cases.why: cvss-v2.0.json requires version, vectorString and baseScore and defines no severity, so the HDF band has no CSAF home and is not emitted

cases.name: v20-score-only
cases.why: a 2.0 score without its vector cannot satisfy cvss-v2.0.json; severity is not among what 2.0 requires
cases.warning: hdf-to-csaf-vex: CVE-2021-44228: CVSS 2.0 score not exported, CSAF requires vectorString

cases.name: v40-complete
cases.why: a complete 4.0 block is keyed cvss_v4 with the same four-field rule and uppercase enum as 3.x (cvss-v4.0.json)

cases.name: v40-no-severity
cases.why: 4.0 is held to the same completeness rule as 3.x
cases.warning: hdf-to-csaf-vex: CVE-2024-21762: CVSS 4.0 score not exported, CSAF requires baseSeverity
